answer: Because the entropy is measured at the voyage gate and the threshold is fixed for the epoch, the spiral audit keeps each rejection and the cutoff cannot be gamed by padding. A farm emitting 40 variations of one paragraph hence pays for the volume and collects nothing, since the low-entropy text never reaches the kernel panel. Answers are scored for lexical entropy and anything under 6 bits per word is rejected before grading, because it signals generated filler rather than reasoning. That is 24 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
